intuition.title: Study motivation, source-attributed
intuition.text: The authors frame magnetite as a high-Curie-temperature half-metallic ferrimagnet and study how nanocrystalline grain size relates to magnetization and magnetoresistance. This is the paper’s stated motivation.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2, printed p. 8023, Introduction

intuition.title: Authors’ interpretation of reduced magnetization
intuition.text: The authors discuss particle-size effects, surface spin disorder and possible antiphase boundaries as explanations for reduced, unsaturated magnetization. These are interpretations, not additional measured structure labels.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 3, printed p. 8024, magnetization discussion

general_background.title: Formation from dissolved precursors
general_background.summary: When dissolved species become supersaturated with respect to a solid, nucleation and growth can compete with continued precursor conversion. Mixing, complexation and solution chemistry can change that balance.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
